title: Sunbirth
description: From the celebrated author of Ghost Music and Braised Pork, a bewitching and atmospheric novel following two sisters in an isolated village as the sun begins to diminish above them.In Five Poems Lake, a small village surrounded by impenetrable deserts, the sun is slowly disappearing overhead.
